lean.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (_hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (_hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(x ⬝ᵥ ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)) *ᵥ x)) / 2)
    (∀ x : Fin n → ℝ, Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * p O x) ((Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))))) ∧
    ∀ (Q : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ) (x : Fin n → ℝ),
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
          p O ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *ᵥ x) ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) =
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * p O x ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))))
approved_definition_context: Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) R is the full real orthogonal group, with inherited real matrix topology and Borel sigma-algebra. Both determinant signs are allowed.

Measure.haarMeasure on top is the actual normalized probability measure on the whole compact group; probability/compactness are supplied internally. It is not an arbitrary or special-orthogonal measure.

Finite real coordinate vectors use dotProduct for the Euclidean quadratic form and matrix mulVec for the orthogonal action. The formula p is a literal real function, not a newly constructed probability measure or a premise asserting density identification.

Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root. Powers with exponent (n:R)/2 are real powers; the dimension is not truncated by natural-number division. Integrable means actual absolute Bochner L1 under the displayed full Haar law.
